title: Redbrand Hideout · Area 2 · Ruffian barracks

sourceRecords.title: 9 · Redbrand barracks · area 2
read: A lamp warms this rough sleeping room. Red cloaks hang from pegs above bedrolls and discarded boots.

The bedding and personal clutter suggest repeated use rather than a room abandoned with the house above. The space between the sleeping places is worth noting before you enter. You can look over what is plainly visible or watch the exit while someone examines the room.

brief: Storeroom converted to barracks: TWO wooden double bunks near the entrance, barrels and crates crowd the southern half. Three dirty scarlet cloaks on pegs. Oil lamps, dressed stone, flagstone floor, ten-foot ceiling. THREE adult human Redbrand ruffians resting, not posing for a fight. No bedroll-only dormitory, no elite armored soldiers, no invented treasure display. This is the initial encounter configuration, not proof these enemies survived.
